title: death bed (coffee for your head)
lyrics:
[00:00.00]Don't stay awake for too long, don't go to bed
[00:05.59]I'll make a cup of coffee for your head
[00:08.99]It'll get you up and going out of bed
[00:12.09]Yeah, I don't wanna fall asleep, I don't wanna pass away
[00:16.26]I been thinking of our future 'cause I'll never see those days
[00:19.59]I don't know why this has happened, but I probably deserve it
[00:23.12]I tried to do my best, but you know that I'm not perfect
[00:26.28]I been praying for forgiveness, you've been praying for my health
[00:29.91]When I leave this earth, hopin' you'll find someone else
[00:32.88]'Cause yeah, we still young, there's so much we haven't done
[00:36.22]Getting married, start a family, watch your husband with his son
[00:39.57]I wish it could be me, but I won't make it out this bed
[00:43.09]I hope I go to heaven so I see you once again
[00:46.45]My life was kinda short, but I got so many blessings
[00:49.88]Happy you were mine, it sucks that it's all ending
[00:53.32]Don't stay awake for too long, don't go to bed
[00:58.91]I'll make a cup of coffee for your head
[01:02.25]It'll get you up and going out of bed (Yeah, aye)
[01:06.64]Don't stay awake for too long, don't go to bed
[01:12.32]I'll make a cup of coffee for your head
[01:15.63]It'll get you up and going out of bed (Aye, yeah)
[01:19.77]I'm happy that you here with me, I'm sorry if I tear up
[01:23.09]When me and you were younger, you would always make me cheer up
[01:26.63]Taking goofy videos and walking through the park
[01:29.52]You would jump into my arms every time you heard a bark
[01:33.30]Cuddle in your sheets, sing me sound asleep
[01:36.37]And sneak out through your kitchen at exactly 1:03
